semantic_adjudication.basis: NL requirement_quote treating 'Closed/SendDeparted' as a single signal; PlantUML source label on transition tr_0003; FCSTM transition forced:09cab4fff112b461:line:39 with triggers=[Closed_SendDeparted] and effects=[]
semantic_adjudication.reason: The NL contract states the transition is 'triggered by the Closed/SendDeparted signal', treating the entire slash-notation as a single signal/event name. PlantUML state machine transition labels (text after the colon) are not a formal trigger/effect decomposition; they are free-text labels. The FCSTM correctly encodes 'Closed_SendDeparted' as a single event in the triggers array, which is consistent with the NL's description of it as one signal. The candidate's reading that the slash implies a mandatory separate effect field is an interpretation of label text, not a contract obligation established by the NL. Since the NL does not distinguish a trigger from an effect in this clause, no violated-obligation reading is established.

issues.requirement_quote: The system in the Cruising substate transitions to the Approaching substate when it approaches the destination, triggered by the "Approached/Decelerate" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Same as REF-020: the event name Approached_Decelerate subsumes the deceleration semantics, and the state transition itself represents the behavior.
issues.title: Effect Decelerate absent from Cruising to Approaching transition

issues.basis: NL9 segment; source state InMotion.Approaching (llms_emp_feedback_final_0004.puml:line:24) shows only 'do/Send'; FCSTM state:Approaching:line:17 has 'during abstract Send' with no other action.
issues.expected: The Approaching state carries an ongoing action representing the approach-destination behavior, in addition to the Send signal.
issues.observed: FCSTM state Approaching (line:17) contains only 'during abstract Send'. No separate action for approach-destination behavior exists. The source PlantUML likewise shows only 'Approaching: do/Send' with no additional do-activity.
issues.reason: The contract requires the Approaching state to have an action 'approach destination'. The FCSTM state has only 'during abstract Send'. No phase hint is present in the contract binding hints, so S4 cannot be applied. The action is absent from both the source and the model, but the contract obligation stands independent of source fidelity.
issues.requirement_quote: In the Approaching substate, the system sends the "Send" signal and continues to approach the destination.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source PlantUML itself does not model 'approach destination' as a separate do-activity; the state name 'Approaching' inherently conveys this behavior. The NL may be describing the state's semantic purpose rather than requiring a distinct named action, and the FCSTM faithfully matches the source.
issues.title: Approach-destination ongoing action absent from Approaching state
